description: Raw data and scripts from "Novel quality metrics for power system diagrams is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Paul Cuffe, Andrew Keane. Just the scrappy data, scripts and figures underlying this conference paper. Uploading now five years later, just for completeness. See: P. Cuffe and A. Keane, "Novel quality metrics for power system diagrams," 2016 IEEE International Energy Conference (ENERGYCON) , 2016, pp. 1-5, doi: 10.1109/ENERGYCON.2016.7514086. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/7514086. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 7077043 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
